observations: 本期严格采用 2026-10-12 至 2026-10-19 的在线发表窗口，五篇精选覆盖限制性内切酶单分子机制、CRISPR RNA 调控的微生物细胞工厂、酶—纳米酶级联组装、数据稀缺酶家族的发现与活性预测，以及工业酶 pH 适应策略。
本期形成一条清晰的方法链：SauUSI 工作解析单个酶分子如何转位并切割甲基化 DNA；hfCas13d/CgRNA 将 RNA 敲低转化为代谢通量调控；EcENN 把中间体传递问题压缩到同一纳米腔室；UPO 工作流则把序列挖掘、表达筛选与活性预测连成闭环。
SauUSI 的切割分布和循环机制来自特定甲基化 DNA 体系；HDA 的 17.8 g/L 与 37.2 g/L 分别属于摇瓶和生物反应器条件；EcENN 的 7 倍产量与 93.1% 转化率属于所报道的 DAAO–Pd 级联；UPO 模型的前瞻测试最高 MCC 为 48%、准确率为 70%，仍显示跨底物空间泛化的限制；pH 适应条目为综述，不是单一工程方案的性能验证。

items.title: Single Staphylococcus aureus SauUSI restriction enzyme motors fragment methylated DNA
items.cn: 单个金黄色葡萄球菌 SauUSI 限制酶马达切碎甲基化 DNA
topics: 酶动力学、选择性与底物特异性
items.summary: 研究者结合生物物理、单分子和纳米孔测序方法，解析二聚体 ATP 依赖型 IV 型限制酶 SauUSI 如何识别并切碎含 5-甲基胞嘧啶或 5-羟甲基胞嘧啶的非己 DNA。甲基化识别首先驱动一个解旋酶样亚基单向转位并置换其靶标识别结构域；在约一半事件中，伙伴结构域结合暴露的修饰位点并稳定不断扩大的 DNA 环。对称甲基化 DNA 更容易形成环，两个马达也可参与双向环转位；切割在转位过程中随机发生，多轮结合—转位—切割最终造成 DNA 碎片化。
items.why: 这项工作把限制酶的终点切割图谱拆解为可观察的马达运动、DNA 成环和随机切割事件，提供了连接单分子动力学与最终片段分布的机制框架。对研究核酸酶、ATP 驱动分子马达和宿主防御系统的人，它是一个方法与机制都值得优先阅读的案例。
items.evidence: Crossref 摘要明确支持：SauUSI 是二聚体、ATP 依赖型 IV 型限制酶；5-甲基胞嘧啶识别诱导单亚基单向转位；伙伴靶标识别结构域可稳定 DNA 环；对称甲基化提高成环并允许双马达参与；切割在转位中随机发生，多轮循环最终切碎修饰 DNA。
items.audience: 限制性内切酶、核酸酶、单分子生物物理、DNA 修饰识别与细菌防御系统研究者
items.verification: Nature Chemical Biology 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-15 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非 paratext 且未标记撤稿；Crossref 未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: Combining biophysical, single-molecule and nanopore-sequencing methods, the authors examine how the dimeric ATP-dependent type IV restriction enzyme SauUSI recognizes and fragments nonself DNA containing 5-methylcytosine or 5-hydroxymethylcytosine. Recognition first drives unidirectional translocation by one helicase-like subunit and displaces its target-recognition domain. In about half of the events, the partner domain binds the exposed modified site and stabilizes a growing DNA loop. Symmetrically methylated DNA loops more often and can engage both motors in bidirectional loop translocation. Cleavage occurs stochastically during translocation, and repeated binding–translocation–cleavage cycles ultimately fragment the DNA.
en.why: The study resolves an endpoint restriction pattern into observable motor movement, DNA looping and stochastic cleavage events. It provides a mechanistic bridge between single-molecule dynamics and the final fragment distribution, making it particularly useful for researchers studying nucleases, ATP-driven molecular motors and host-defence systems.
en.evidence: The Crossref abstract supports SauUSI as a dimeric ATP-dependent type IV restriction enzyme, methylcytosine-triggered unidirectional translocation by one subunit, stabilization of a DNA loop by the partner target-recognition domain, more frequent looping and dual-motor engagement on symmetrically methylated DNA, stochastic cleavage during translocation, and eventual fragmentation through repeated cycles.
en.audience: Researchers in restriction enzymes, nucleases, single-molecule biophysics, DNA-modification recognition and bacterial defence systems
en.verification: The Nature Chemical Biology publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 15 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex classifies the work as an article, not paratext, and does not mark it as retracted; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation.

items.title: Coupling hfCas13d with Circular gRNA Array Precursors Extends RNA Knockdown and Improves Biocatalysis in Yeast
items.cn: hfCas13d 与环状 gRNA 阵列前体耦合，延长 RNA 敲低并提升酵母生物催化
items.topic: 酶的应用与环境生物催化
topics: 酶的应用与环境生物催化
酶催化方法与分析技术
items.summary: 研究者在 Candida viswanathii 中重构三种哺乳动物来源的 CRISPR RNA 切割系统，用于阻断中间代谢反应并生产尼龙前体羟基癸酸（HDA）。筛选确定 hfCas13d 为较优效应器，随后设计环状 guide RNA（CgRNA）前体以增强并延长相关基因的敲低。单阵列和双阵列可实现多重通路抑制；双阵列降低副产物形成，使 HDA 在摇瓶中的滴度达到 17.8 g/L，生物反应器发酵进一步达到 37.2 g/L。
items.why: 它把可编程 RNA 切割从基因功能工具推进到代谢流动态调控，并用产物滴度验证了多重敲低的工艺价值。对细胞工厂研究者，值得关注的不只是 Cas13d 本身，还包括环状 gRNA 架构对敲低持续时间和多靶点组合的影响。
items.evidence: Nature Communications 出版商摘要支持：研究在 C. viswanathii 中比较三种 RNA 切割系统并选出 hfCas13d；CgRNA 前体增强并延长 HDA 通路相关基因敲低；该平台也能在其他酵母和大肠杆菌中抑制基因；双阵列减少副产物，使 HDA 滴度在摇瓶和生物反应器中分别达到 17.8 g/L 和 37.2 g/L。
items.audience: 代谢工程、合成生物学、CRISPR RNA 工具、酵母细胞工厂与工业生物催化研究者
items.verification: Nature Communications 出版商页面确认文章类别为 Article、发表日期为 2026-10-15，并提供摘要；Crossref DOI 与日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非 paratext 且未标记撤稿；Crossref 未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The authors reconstitute three mammalian CRISPR RNA-cleavage systems in Candida viswanathii to interrupt intermediate metabolic reactions during production of hydroxydecanoic acid (HDA), a nylon precursor. They identify hfCas13d as the preferred effector and design a circular guide-RNA precursor architecture to strengthen and extend knockdown of pathway genes. Single and dual arrays enable multiplexed repression; the dual arrays reduce by-product formation and raise the HDA titre to 17.8 g/L in shake flasks, with bioreactor fermentation reaching 37.2 g/L.
en.why: The study moves programmable RNA cleavage from a gene-function tool toward dynamic control of metabolic flux and validates multiplexed knockdown with product titres. For cell-factory researchers, the key point is not only Cas13d but also how the circular guide architecture affects knockdown duration and multi-target combinations.
en.evidence: The Nature Communications publisher abstract supports comparison of three RNA-cleavage systems in C. viswanathii, selection of hfCas13d, stronger and longer knockdown with circular guide-RNA precursors, repression in other yeasts and E. coli, reduced by-product formation with dual arrays, and HDA titres of 17.8 g/L in shake flasks and 37.2 g/L in a bioreactor.
en.audience: Researchers in metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, CRISPR RNA tools, yeast cell factories and industrial biocatalysis
en.verification: The Nature Communications publisher page identifies the work as an Article, gives a publication date of 15 October 2026 and provides the abstract. The Crossref DOI and date were checked. OpenAlex classifies it as an article, not paratext, and does not mark it as retracted; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation.

items.title: Nanoconfined Protein Scaffold as a Generalizable Platform Empowers Synergistic Enzyme–Nanozyme Catalysis for Cascade Biotransformation
items.cn: 纳米限域蛋白支架构建协同酶—纳米酶级联生物转化平台
topics: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 研究者将天然装载货物的 encapsulin 改造为纳米反应器，在同一限域腔体内组装 D-氨基酸氧化酶（DAAO）与钯纳米酶。DAAO 通过靶向肽在自组装过程中选择性封装，钯纳米酶则在腔内生物矿化，用于原位清除有毒副产物。分子动力学模拟显示钯纳米酶富集在酶表面附近，可减少中间体扩散损失；该体系在实验室条件下使丙酮酸滴度提高 7 倍，并在中试尺度获得最高 93.1% 的转化率，而游离 DAAO 为 49.7%。
items.why: 这项工作把级联催化的三个常见瓶颈——组分共定位、中间体传递和副产物清除——合并到一个可编程蛋白纳米腔室中。它为酶与无机催化单元的空间组织提供了可测量的设计案例，特别适合关注级联组装和过程放大的研究者。
items.evidence: ACS Nano 摘要支持：encapsulin 被用于共同容纳靶向肽融合的 DAAO 与腔内生物矿化的 Pd 纳米酶；Pd 组分用于原位消除有毒副产物；分子动力学提示其在酶表面富集并减少扩散损失；EcENN 在实验室条件下将丙酮酸滴度提高 7 倍，中试转化率最高为 93.1%，对照游离 DAAO 为 49.7%。
items.audience: 酶级联组装、酶—纳米材料体系、蛋白纳米反应器、α-酮酸合成与过程生物催化研究者
items.verification: ACS Nano 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-15 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非 paratext 且未标记撤稿；Crossref 未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: The authors repurpose the naturally cargo-loading protein encapsulin as a nanoreactor that houses D-amino acid oxidase (DAAO) and palladium nanozymes in the same confined cavity. A targeting-peptide fusion selectively packages DAAO during self-assembly, while the palladium component is biomineralized inside the compartment to remove a toxic by-product in situ. Molecular-dynamics simulations indicate enrichment of the nanozyme near the enzyme surface, reducing intermediate diffusion losses. The system raises pyruvate titres sevenfold under laboratory conditions and reaches up to 93.1% conversion at pilot scale, compared with 49.7% for free DAAO.
en.why: The work combines three recurrent cascade-design problems—component colocalization, intermediate transfer and by-product removal—within a programmable protein compartment. It offers a measurable design case for spatially organizing enzymatic and inorganic catalytic units, particularly for researchers interested in cascade assembly and process scale-up.
en.evidence: The ACS Nano abstract supports encapsulin-mediated co-compartmentalization of targeting-peptide-tagged DAAO and biomineralized palladium nanozymes, in situ removal of a toxic by-product, simulation-based enrichment of palladium near the enzyme surface with reduced diffusion loss, a sevenfold increase in pyruvate titre in laboratory experiments, and pilot-scale conversion of up to 93.1% versus 49.7% for free DAAO.
en.audience: Researchers in enzyme cascade assembly, enzyme–nanomaterial systems, protein nanoreactors, α-keto-acid synthesis and process biocatalysis
en.verification: The ACS Nano publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 15 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex classifies the work as an article, not paratext, and does not mark it as retracted; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation.

items.title: An Integrated Computational-Experimental Workflow for Fungal Peroxygenase Discovery and Enzyme–Substrate Prediction
items.cn: 用于真菌过氧化物酶发现与酶—底物预测的计算—实验一体化流程
items.journal: Journal of Chemical Information and Modeling
topics: AI 与机器学习辅助酶研究
items.summary: 该研究以数据稀缺且异源表达困难的真菌非特异性过氧化物酶（UPO）为案例，建立从大规模序列挖掘、表达可行性排序、实验筛选到酶—底物活性预测的一体化流程。研究从 3000 多条候选序列中筛出 59 条，在大肠杆菌中分两批表达并获得 27 个表达和活性一致的 UPO；随后用 15 个新 UPO、4 个参考酶和 27 种底物建立活性数据集。两类梯度提升模型分别使用结构/对接特征与蛋白—化学语言模型嵌入；回顾性验证最高 MCC 为 55%、准确率为 78%，对未见第二批酶的前瞻测试最高 MCC 为 48%、准确率为 70%。
items.why: 它没有把模型性能与实验发现割裂，而是展示了小样本酶家族中如何主动生成数据、筛出可表达酶，再用互补表征做下一轮优先级排序。更重要的是，作者保留了前瞻测试结果和跨化学空间泛化限制，给出了比单一高分指标更可信的工程边界。
items.evidence: Crossref 摘要支持：流程从 3000 多条序列筛至 59 条候选，获得 27 个稳定表达且有活性的 UPO；15 个新 UPO 和 4 个参考序列对 27 种底物构成数据集；两种梯度提升协议分别整合结构/对接特征和蛋白/化学语言模型嵌入；回顾性测试最高 MCC 55%、准确率 78%，选定的前瞻测试最高 MCC 48%、准确率 70%，摘要同时指出向更广底物空间泛化仍具挑战。
items.audience: 新酶挖掘、UPO/过氧化物酶、酶—底物预测、蛋白语言模型与数据稀缺酶家族研究者
items.verification: JCIM 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-16 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非 paratext 且未标记撤稿；Crossref 未见更正或撤稿关系。

en.summary: Using fungal unspecific peroxygenases (UPOs), a data-poor family that is difficult to express heterologously, the study builds an integrated workflow from large-scale sequence mining and expression-aware prioritization to experimental screening and enzyme–substrate activity prediction. More than 3,000 sequences are narrowed to 59 candidates, expressed in two E. coli batches, and reduced to 27 UPOs with consistent expression and activity. Fifteen novel UPOs, four reference enzymes and 27 substrates then form the activity data set. Two gradient-boosting protocols use either structure and docking features or joint protein/chemical language-model embeddings. Retrospective performance reaches an MCC of 55% and 78% accuracy; selected prospective tests on unseen second-batch enzymes reach an MCC of 48% and 70% accuracy.
en.why: Rather than separating model performance from experimental discovery, the paper shows how to generate targeted data in a small enzyme family, identify expressible enzymes and use complementary representations to prioritize the next round. Its prospective results and explicit limits on generalization across chemical space provide a more credible engineering boundary than a single retrospective score.
en.evidence: The Crossref abstract supports narrowing more than 3,000 sequences to 59 candidates, obtaining 27 consistently expressed and active UPOs, building a data set from 15 novel UPOs, four references and 27 substrates, and training two gradient-boosting protocols using structure/docking features or protein/chemical language-model embeddings. It reports retrospective maxima of 55% MCC and 78% accuracy, prospective maxima of 48% MCC and 70% accuracy, and an unresolved challenge in generalizing to broader substrate space.
en.audience: Researchers in enzyme mining, UPOs and peroxygenases, enzyme–substrate prediction, protein language models and data-poor enzyme families
en.verification: The JCIM publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 16 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex classifies the work as an article, not paratext, and does not mark it as retracted; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation.

items.title: Enhancing Enzyme pH Adaptation for Industrial Biocatalysis: From Sequence-Dependent Engineering to Sequence-Independent Stabilization
items.cn: 提升工业生物催化中的酶 pH 适应性：从序列依赖工程到序列无关稳定化
topics: 酶固定化与酶—材料体系
items.summary: 这篇综述围绕工业酶在非天然酸碱条件下活性、催化效率与结构完整性下降的问题，对比两类干预路径。序列依赖方法包括理性设计、定向进化、突变、截短、融合和环化，但通常需要结构知识或大规模筛选，并可能面临稳定性—活性权衡；序列无关方法则尝试在不改变主要催化序列的前提下稳定酶，重点讨论与稳定伙伴共表达和蛋白添加剂形成的分子屏蔽策略及其简便性、可扩展性和工艺兼容性。
items.why: pH 适应常被简化为几个表面电荷突变，但工业体系还需要考虑筛选成本、放大兼容性和活性权衡。这篇综述的阅读价值在于把改序列与不改序列的策略放入同一决策框架，帮助研究者判断何时应继续蛋白工程，何时应转向配方或伴侣稳定化。
items.evidence: Crossref 摘要支持：非天然 pH 会改变可电离残基质子化状态并扰动催化微环境与稳定相互作用；综述涵盖理性设计、定向进化、突变、截短、融合和环化等序列依赖方法，也讨论稳定伙伴共表达和蛋白添加剂等序列无关的分子屏蔽策略。摘要提出这些方法具有潜力，但没有给出统一的跨酶性能增益。
items.audience: 工业酶工程、pH 稳定性、蛋白配方、洗涤剂/纺织/生物炼制与生物催化工艺研究者
items.verification: ACS Synthetic Biology 出版信息、Crossref DOI、摘要与 2026-10-13 在线发表日期已核验；OpenAlex 标记为 article、非 paratext 且未标记撤稿；Crossref 未见更正或撤稿关系。文章按摘要内容归类为 review。

en.summary: This review examines why industrial enzymes lose activity, catalytic efficiency or structural integrity under non-native acidic or alkaline conditions and compares two intervention routes. Sequence-dependent approaches include rational design, directed evolution, mutagenesis, truncation, fusion and circularization, but often require structural knowledge or extensive screening and may introduce stability–activity trade-offs. Sequence-independent approaches seek to preserve performance without altering the primary catalytic sequence, with emphasis on molecular shielding through co-expression with stabilizing partners and the use of protein additives, including their potential simplicity, scalability and process compatibility.
en.why: pH adaptation is often reduced to a few surface-charge mutations, whereas industrial use also requires attention to screening cost, scale-up compatibility and activity trade-offs. The review is useful because it places sequence-changing and sequence-preserving strategies in one decision framework, helping readers judge when to continue protein engineering and when to consider formulation or partner-based stabilization.
en.evidence: The Crossref abstract supports changes in ionizable-residue protonation and disruption of catalytic microenvironments and stabilizing interactions at non-native pH. It covers sequence-dependent rational design, directed evolution, mutagenesis, truncation, fusion and circularization, as well as sequence-independent molecular shielding through stabilizing partners and protein additives. The abstract presents these approaches as promising but does not report a uniform performance gain across enzymes.
en.audience: Researchers in industrial enzyme engineering, pH stability, protein formulation, detergents, textiles, biorefineries and biocatalytic processes
en.verification: The ACS Synthetic Biology publication information, Crossref DOI, abstract and online publication date of 13 October 2026 were checked. OpenAlex classifies the work as an article, not paratext, and does not mark it as retracted; Crossref lists no correction or retraction relation. The paper is categorized here as a review based on its abstract.

observationsEn: Using the strict online-publication window of 12–19 October 2026, this edition features five papers on the single-molecule mechanism of a restriction enzyme, CRISPR RNA control in microbial cell factories, enzyme–nanozyme cascade assembly, discovery and activity prediction in a data-poor enzyme family, and pH-adaptation strategies for industrial enzymes.

The papers form a useful methodological chain: SauUSI resolves how one enzyme translocates and cleaves methylated DNA; hfCas13d/CgRNA turns RNA knockdown into metabolic-flux control; EcENN compresses intermediate transfer into one nanocompartment; and the UPO workflow closes the loop between sequence mining, expression screening and activity prediction.

The SauUSI cleavage distribution and cycling mechanism belong to the tested methylated-DNA systems. The HDA titres of 17.8 and 37.2 g/L come from shake-flask and bioreactor conditions, respectively. EcENN's sevenfold titre increase and 93.1% conversion belong to the reported DAAO–Pd cascade. Prospective UPO prediction reaches at most 48% MCC and 70% accuracy and still shows limits across broader substrate space. The pH-adaptation paper is a review, not a performance validation of one engineering solution.
